apps.localizedDescription:
Git Writer:

A minimalistic, cross-platform note-taking app that uses Git repositories to keep your Markdown notes version-controlled and synchronized across devices. Supports all major platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS).

Used technologies::

• Git Integration: JGit (Desktop and Android), libgit2.
• Image & File Handling: Coil 3 & FileKit.
• Markdown parsing & rendering: multiplatform-markdown-renderer & jetbrains-markdown.

Spell Checking:

• misspellings are checked against the spell check language in the app settings, which defaults to the app language.

Package names include the region: hunspell-es and hunspell-cs, but hunspell-de-de on Debian and Ubuntu. Chinese is not spell checked, hunspell has no dictionary with word segmentation.

versions.localizedDescription:
GitWriter 1.1.0:

• Encrypt your notes 🔐.

E2EE notebooks The notebook password can't be recovered. Without it, nobody can read the notes on the remote. The notes on your devices stay readable.

Added:

• Encrypted notebooks: turn on Encrypt notebook in the notebook settings and set a password. The remote (e.g. GitHub) then only gets encrypted data, so it can't see note text, note names or folders. It needs a new, empty repository.
• Export to PDF: export a note to a PDF file.
• Widget "New note" button: creates a note in the root of the active notebook and opens it.
• Formatting shortcuts and the mobile toolbar buttons now format the selected text (toggle formatting) instead of only inserting the characters.

Fixes:

• Automatic sync no longer runs while the device is offline.
• Empty lines between two lists are kept, so the lists don't merge into one after reopening the note.
• HTML tags in a note are shown as dimmed text instead of empty blocks.
• The Android home screen widget is fixed (previously stuck in a loading) - added ProGuard rules.
